content.description:
Adorable, cuddly and unique, CryptoKnitties are collectable knitted NFT companions for your Cardano Blockchain wallet! There are 10K unique CryptoKnitties with different props and quantities of extra items. Within the set there are ‘black label’ CryptoKnitties that are crazy rare! You can find out more about CryptoKnitties by joining our amazing community over on Twitter and Discord.

Knitties Season 1 consisted of 10.000 globally unique avatars with a variety of yarn colors, props, and accessories.
